_about: The recipe .github/workflows/board-rebuild.yml rebuilds the 9 Nov board from (layout v4; Krish, 2026-11-07: "I think we should redesign the 9th of November board as well."). The run gives --previous (the live board it downloads) and --out; this file gives the rest, as week_board.py's own flags. Monday is kept exactly as the live board holds it (made; its six downloads mapped in board-assets.json), Wednesday and Friday keep their words in review as they stand, and each takes v4's steps. Everything else the live board carries (briefs, titles, off days, manifests, production gates) is kept by --previous. assets is what board_web.py publish-web takes.
